candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its downstream order call times out: traces show POST order and POST payment failing with transport ReadTimeout (~2s), while inventory/redis succeed in ms. Order's payment dependency stalls, propagating latency to checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Order/payment service-side telemetry absent; the specific slow hop (payment vs order) is inferred from client spans only.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s at ~2s align with client-side ReadTimeout on order and payment calls in traces and logs; inventory/redis complete in milliseconds. Gateway p95 for /v1/checkout is ~2387ms. This points to downstream latency at the order/payment path rather than gateway-internal failure.
missing_evidence: Order and payment service traces/metrics to confirm which hop exceeds the ~2s timeout
Payment service latency/error metrics during the incident window
